name: Banking details then branch follow-up
description: Customer first asks for banking details, then follows up asking which branch to use. AI should use get_banking then get_branch.

messages.text: Please send me your banking details for a deposit.
Which branch should I go to?

expected_behaviors.description: First reply should contain account details
Second reply should mention a branch
Each reply should arrive within 15 seconds

notes: Two-message scenario testing sequential get_banking then get_branch tool use with a 6s gap.
